ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.FK_RBVRkb') AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.RachunkiBankoweVat')) ALTER TABLE CDN.RachunkiBankoweVat DROP CONSTRAINT FK_RBVRkb;
ALTER TABLE CDN.RachunkiBankoweVat ADD CONSTRAINT FK_RBVRkb FOREIGN KEY ( RBV_RkbId ) REFERENCES CDN.RachunkiBankowe ( RkB_Id ) ON DELETE CASCADE ;
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.FK_TrJPrimary') AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.TraJPK')) ALTER TABLE CDN.TraJPK DROP CONSTRAINT FK_TrJPrimary;
ALTER TABLE CDN.TraJPK ADD CONSTRAINT FK_TrJPrimary FOREIGN KEY ( TrJ_TrNNumer ) REFERENCES CDN.TraNag ( TrN_GIDNumer ) ON DELETE CASCADE ;
